Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #spud #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #lasagna

Ingredients: 1 tbsp salted butter 1 can (14oz)sweetened condensed milk  2/3 cup sweetened coconut flakes  Sugar coating: 1 cup granulated sugar 1/2 cup water 1 tbsp vinegar  How to: In a sauce pan add butter and turn it on medium heat until melted. Next add in sweetened condensed milk and coconut flakes. Stir on medium heat for 5-7 minutes until the mixture is thickened and can pull away from the pan. Add it into a separate bowl and place in the refrigerator until cooled.  Once cooled, take a tbsp of the mixture and roll it between greased hands to form a ball and place it onto a parchment lined pan until all of the mixture is formed into bite sized balls. Next in a sauce, pan, combine sugar, water, and vinegar. Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally, until it turns amber in color. Take off the heat. Next insert a toothpick into each ball and dip it into the amber sugar and place back onto a parchment lined pan.  Let cool and serve! #dessert #coconut #balabaiana #easyrecipe #recipeshare

Creamy Pesto Chicken Pasta Bake ✨ My most viral recipe of 2024!  What a year it’s been. I’m truly so grateful for all the love and support you’ve shown me this year. Cheers to a delicious 2025!  Here’s how to make it: 1lb pasta of choice 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes + oil 1lb chicken 1 tbsp butter 1/2 yellow onion, diced Salt and pepper, to taste 1 tsp red pepper flakes (to taste) 1 tsp smoked paprika (to taste) 1 tsp oregano (to taste) 6-8 cloves of garlic, minced (to taste) 2 cups heavy cream (room temp) 1-2 cups cooked broccoli  2 handfuls spinach 6-8 oz freshly shredded parmesan cheese (divided) 8 oz freshly shredded mozzarella (divided) 1/2 cup pesto, to taste (I recommend Costco brand) Parsley to garnish  1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Place the cream on the counter to come to room temp. 2. Boil your noodles in salted water a few minutes less than package instructions (al dente). Drain and set aside.  3. In a large oven-safe saucepan or dutch oven, heat 1 tbsp of sun-dried tomato oil over medium heat. Cook the chicken until it's no longer pink, then remove it from the pan and set it aside. Let it rest for a few minutes before cutting into bite-sized pieces. 4. In the same pan, melt the butter and add salt, pepper, red pepper, paprika, and oregano. Stir to toast, then toss in the onion and sauté for about 4 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 5. Turn heat to low, pour in the heavy cream and stir. Let it simmer for a couple of minutes to thicken slightly. 6. Add half of the parmesan and 1 cup of mozzarella cheese,  stir until the cheese is melted. 7. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes, cooked broccoli, spinach, chicken, cooked pasta, and pesto. 8. Top with the remaining mozzarella and parmesan cheese.  9. Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes, then broil for another 5 minutes, or until the top is golden and bubbly. 10. Sprinkle with fresh parsley, a little more parmesan, and enjoy! #pastabake #chickenpesto #pesto #pestopasta #pestochicken #pasta #pastarecipe #easyrecipe #easyrecipes #easymeal #easydinner #dinnerideas #dinner #foodtok #cooking

Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps🍗🧀🌯 The flavours are absolutely phenomenal, one of the best wraps made using a sheet pan. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy. 3. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper, spread marinated chicken evenly (do not overcrowd), add light layer of cooking spray then bake in a preheated oven for 20-22 mins at 200C until crispy. 4. While chicken is still hot, add extra parmesan and parsley. Mix well until coated and extra cheesy. 5. Assemble the wraps with shredded lettuce, onion, tomato, crispy chicken and sauce. ENJOY! Storage and Reheating Tips - Store chicken and creamy sauce in separate containers in the fridge. - When ready to eat, just warm up chicken in oven/air fryer for 4-5 mins 180C / 370F. Ingredients • 1 lb ground pork • 1/3 cup green onions, thinly sliced • 1 tbsp fresh ginger, grated • 4 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp oyster sauce • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tbsp chili crisp • 3 tbsp soy sauce • 1½ tsp sesame oil • 1 tbsp rice vinegar • 18–20 dumpling wrappers • 1/4 cup chicken broth • Avocado oil For Topping • Soy sauce • Chili crisp • Green onions • Sesame seeds Instructions 1. In a bowl, combine the ground pork, green onions, grated ginger, garlic, oyster sauce, black pepper, chili crisp, soy sauce, sesame oil, and rice vinegar. Mix until fully combined. 2. Use a cookie scoop to place mounds of the filling onto a sheet pan, leaving enough space between each one. 3. Place a dumpling wrapper over each mound and pinch the edges around the filling to seal. 4. Drizzle with avocado oil, pour in the chicken broth, cover, and steam for 10 minutes, or until the pork reaches an internal temperature of 160°F. 5. Top with soy sauce, chili crisp, green onions, and sesame seeds before serving with a side of rice. #easydinners #dumpling #blanketdumplings

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Crispy garlic parmesan chicken rolls Ingredients  For the chicken: 2 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  2 tsp paprika powder  1/2 tsp cumin powder  1 tbsp lemon juice  1 tbsp oil (for marinating) 1 small yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 2 tbsp oil for cooking  For the garlic parmesan sauce: 1 tbsp butter  1 tbsp garlic, minced  1 1/2 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream 1 tbsp cream cheese  Salt to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1 tsp red chili flakes  1 cup Parmesan cheese , freshly grated  1 tsp parsley , finely chopped  To assemble: 9-10 small flour tortilla wraps 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for pan frying  Method: Season chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cumin, lemon juice, and oil. I’ve received 100s of messages from you about how this recipe has become a staple in your family’s dinner routine 🥹 Some of you are making it WEEKLY and I’ve gotten so much feedback specifically that your kids are loving it - which makes me so happy! Let me know in the comments how YOU enjoy this easy recipe and share it with someone you think would love this crowd-pleasing chuck roast!  Ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast (about 4 pounds) 2 teaspoons kosher sea salt  1 teaspoon black pepper  Instructions: Preheat your oven to 325. Season the roast generously on both sides with salt and pepper. Add to a baking large casserole dish or Dutch oven, cover (with a lid or foil), and bake for 1 hr per pound of meat. Remove the roast from the oven and raise the oven temperate to 425.  Using two forks, shred the meat into large chunks. (If the roast is not pulling apart easily, put it back in the oven for 30 min). Toss the shredded pieces of roast around in the rendered fat and place it back in the oven, uncovered, for 20-25 minutes until you see some nice crispy ends.  Serve with mashed potatoes or roasted vegetables and enjoy! FAQs:  My roast is less than 4 lbs, how long should I cook it? Use the “hour per pound” method. How do I choose a good beef chuck roast? Look for nice fatty roast with lots of marbling. A roast that is too lean will not render enough juice. (Note: I have hit or miss luck with grass-fed roasts. Most are just too tough/lean and don't render enough fat for this preparation.)  How many people does this serve? A 4-pound roast serves 6-7 people. Do I need to sear it first?  Nope! The last part of the cook will give it some nice crispy bits without searing.  Did you add liquid? No, that is the juice rendered from the meat. My take on the viral beef kebab roll ups 😮‍💨🔥  What You’ll Need: For the Beef 	•	1 lb ground beef (80/20 works best) 	•	1 tbsp olive oil 	•	¼–½ cup finely diced onion 	•	¼–½ cup finely diced bell pepper 	•	Small handful fresh parsley, finely chopped 	•	2 garlic cloves, minced 	•	1 tsp curry powder 	•	1 tsp beef bouillon 	•	1 tsp garlic powder 	•	1 tsp onion powder 	•	1 tsp black pepper 	•	2 tsp paprika 	•	½ tsp cumin 	•	Salt to taste For Assembly 	•	Lavash bread or large flour tortillas 	•	Wooden skewers, soaked in water For the Chili Butter 	•	2 tbsp butter 	•	1 tbsp olive oil 	•	1 tsp tomato paste 	•	3 tsp paprika 	•	Salt to taste 	•	Optional: pinch of chili flakes for heat For Serving 	•	Plain yogurt or garlic yogurt 	•	Fresh parsley 	•	Lemon wedges How To Make Them Mix together the ground beef, onion, bell pepper, garlic, parsley, olive oil, and seasonings until smooth and slightly sticky. Cover and refrigerate for 20–30 minutes while soaking your skewers in water. Spread a thin layer of the beef mixture onto lavash bread or tortillas, roll tightly, then slice into pieces. Thread onto skewers, packing them closely together. Bake at 400°F for 20–25 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden and cooked through. For the chili butter, melt together the butter and olive oil, then stir in the tomato paste, paprika, salt, and chili flakes if using. Let it cook for 30 seconds until glossy and fragrant. Brush the skewers generously with the chili butter, then broil for 1–2 minutes until lightly charred and crispy around the edges. Serve over garlic yogurt or alongside fries, then finish with fresh parsley and a squeeze of lemon. #cookwithme #kurveyskitchen #easymeals #viralfood #kebab

Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Slice butter into 12 slices. Place 2 slices vertically in 6 sections on the prepared baking sheet. Top each set of butter slices with 1 tablespoon brown sugar. Slice partially frozen cream cheese into 12 slices. Set 2 slices side by side on top of brown sugar sections. Lightly roll puff pastry on a lightly floured surface. Cut pastry sheet into 6 rectangles. Press pastry around each mound of cream cheese mixture, pressing slightly down on the cream cheese. Use a fork to crimp the edges of each pastry. Brush pastries with beaten egg. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown and flaky, 15 to 18 minutes. Let stand on the baking sheet for 10 minutes before carefully turning over. Meanwhile, whisk together confectioner’s sugar and milk until smooth. Chicken, Rice & Feta Bake 🍅🍗🧀 One baking dish, 6 meals, and almost 50g of protein per serving. Meal prep doesn’t need to be complicated. Macros (per serving – makes 6) Calories – 491 Protein – 51g Carbs – 32g Fat – 17g Ingredients 🥣  2 lbs or ~900g Chicken Breast, Raw 600g or ~4 cups Cherry Tomatoes 8 oz or 227g Block Feta Cheese 1 medium Red Onion, diced 1 cup or ~165g Corn 5 cloves Garlic, roughly chopped 2 tbsp or 30ml Olive Oil 400g Cooked Jasmine Rice or ~135g / 3/4 cup Dry Jasmine Rice 3 tbsp Grated Parmesan-Romano Fresh Basil for Topping  Seasonings to taste  Salt Black Pepper Paprika Oregano How to make 🧑‍🍳  1️⃣ Add the cherry tomatoes, diced onion, corn, garlic, and chicken breasts to a large baking dish. Place the block of feta in the center, drizzle everything with olive oil, then season with salt, pepper, paprika, and oregano. 2️⃣ Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 35–40 minutes, or until the chicken is fully cooked and reaches 165°F (75°C) internally. 3️⃣ While everything is baking, cook your jasmine rice according to the package directions. 4️⃣ Remove the baking dish from the oven. Shred the chicken, then mash the feta and tomatoes and mix everything together until you have a creamy sauce. 5️⃣ Add 400g of your cooked rice and mix until the rice and chicken are completely coated in the feta and tomato sauce. 6️⃣ Top with grated Parmesan and fresh basil, then place back in the oven for another 10 minutes. 7️⃣ Take it out, let it cool for a few minutes, portion into 6 servings, and enjoy!
